doc: Maternal dietary antigen avoidance during pregnancy or lactation or both for preventing or treating atopic disease in the child

entries.claim: 孕妇在孕期不需要为了避免孩子过敏而回避特定食物（如牛奶、鸡蛋），因为证据不足且可能影响母婴营养。
entries.source_doc: Maternal dietary antigen avoidance during pregnancy or lactation or both for preventing or treating atopic disease in the child

entries.claim: 哺乳期高风险母亲回避抗原饮食可能稍微降低孩子患湿疹的风险，但现有证据不充分，需要更多高质量试验。
entries.source_doc: Maternal dietary antigen avoidance during pregnancy or lactation or both for preventing or treating atopic disease in the child

entries.claim: 哺乳期母亲回避饮食（如牛奶、鸡蛋）可能减轻已患湿疹婴儿的严重程度，但需要更大规模的试验证实。
entries.source_doc: Maternal dietary antigen avoidance during pregnancy or lactation or both for preventing or treating atopic disease in the child
